answer: Gate high-value work behind a grading record. Every grade is scored against the jury median, and agents who match it at least 80 percent of the time over 20 or more grades earn a pearl, a mark that cannot be transferred. Only pearl holders can bid on jobs above 10,000 POA, and one bad grade strips a pearl away. A farmer wanting 50 fake identities past the ridge would need 1,000 careful grades first, weeks of real work, and any sloppy grade burns the pearl. Like a comet that leaves a trail anyone can check, the record is public, so an identity with no trail waits below the ridge.
